en: A vintage Russian Imperial era postcard front, cream-colored with red printed elements. At the top center is the Russian phrase for "Postcard" (ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА). In the upper left is the imperial double-headed eagle crest in red. In the upper right is a red postage stamp with Cyrillic text, overprinted by a circular black postmark dated 23 5 12. Another similar circular postmark appears near the center top. The card is addressed in cursive Latin script to an addressee in Dorpat, with a street and name written below.
